summary: All six blocking faults from critique pass 1 are fixed and independently re-measured: sheet chrome now composites at frame scale (heading cap height ~50px matching the in-frame title, 70px gutters), Option A's toolbar no longer bleeds body text, A's secondary frame genuinely shows replies below the fold, reply body text is flush at the card's leading edge, Option C's toolbar chip measures 43.3pt at parity with Close/Edit and carries real J/M monograms, and all six frames share a 9:28 clock with C's back affordance restyled to a ghost pill 'Note'. Contrast measured clean throughout (reply body 17.5:1, timestamps 8.2:1, composer placeholder 6.3:1). Seven residual issues remain — an over-heavy opaque toolbar strip vs the real translucent bar, frames captured as a root view rather than the presented sheet, no paragraph spacing in the sample note body, slightly weaker card separation inside B's drawer, a half-clipped body line under B's docked bar, C's chip pulling Edit into a shared iOS 26 toolbar group, plus the pre-existing Dynamic Type and personal-note backend gaps — all recorded in critique.md as /build handoff notes; none of them changes which option a reader would pick, so the sheet is passed rather than looped again.
